item.title: The Supreme Court struck down a bunch of Trump's tariffs. Now what?
item.description: Live event info and tickets here.The Supreme Court has spoken. Those big, sweeping tariffs that President Trump imposed early last year? They’re illegal. On today’s show: Why were those tariffs struck down? Will anyone get refunds? And …what about this new 10 percent tariff the President just announced today? item.title: Niia at Blue Note
item.description: Niia at Blue NoteFeb. 23. 8PM and 10:30PM The singer Niia, born Niia Bertino, is a musical agent provocateur, who lures in jazz audiences with smoky versions of songs like “Angel Eyes” and even “The Christmas Song” and then hits them with her own dance-oriented, occasionally X-rated originals. As a songwriter Niia draws freely on soul, hip hop and rock, and she recently put out her fifth album of her own works. That album is simply called V, (the Roman numeral five). item.title: Six Organs of Admittance at Union Pool
item.description: Six Organs of Admittance at Union PoolFeb. 24. 7PM. FREE Since just before the turn of the century, Six Organs of Admittance has been releasing albums and listeners have been trying to figure out what to call it. Six Organs Of Admittance is the work of guitarist Ben Chasny; sometimes there are other musicians, sometimes there aren’t. item.title: Sister Sadie at Joe's Pub
item.description: Sister Sadie at Joe's PubFeb. 25. 7PM. $36. Sister Sadie began back in 2012 as a one-off, when five leading women on the Nashville bluegrass scene got together to play what they thought would be a single gig. Instead, the band has gone on to release four albums and gather two Grammy nominations, and while the lineup has changed over the years, the commitment to a traditional roots music sound has not. item.title: Mavis Staples at the Beacon Theatre
item.description: Mavis Staples at the Beacon TheatreFeb. 28. 8PM. $63.65 Mavis Staples has been one of the great voices in American popular music since the 60s. Now 86, she is still touring and making records; her last, Sad And Beautiful World, came out in November, and the title track is indeed both sad and beautiful.
